description: Give the house_app role the access it needs, and nothing else.
rationale: Last on purpose, and the dependency list is honest rather than defensive: GRANT ... ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA reaches the tables that exist when it runs and no others, so every table and view specification really is a prerequisite. A table added after this one is not covered by it, which is a fact about GRANT and not something a migration tool can paper over -- the next such table brings its own grant. house_app gets no DDL rights at all: it cannot create, drop or alter anything, which is the boundary a separate schema was created to make expressible. Note that a revoke takes effect on already-connected sessions at their next statement, so this is not a change that waits for a restart.
